# GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand.
#   python tools/generate_offices.py
#
# Household offices. See the docstring in the generator for why offices are
# auto_modifiers keyed on country variables rather than traits.
#
# Household tab card buttons. Appoint fires cc_office.3 with the most
# senior eligible ministers as options; Dismiss vacates the post.

# Seneschal
cc_office_seneschal_appoint = {
	type = owncountry
	price = price:cc_office_appointment
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_xp_enabled = yes
			cc_office_seneschal_exists = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_office_seneschal_vacant = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = cc_office_tt_room
				cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = cc_office_seneschal_tt_candidate
				any_cabinet_character = {
					cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
					cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = cc_office_seneschal_tt }
			hidden_effect = {
				cc_office_panel_clear = yes
				set_variable = { name = cc_office_panel_seneschal  value = yes  months = 1 }
			}
			trigger_event_silently = { id = cc_office.3 }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}

cc_office_seneschal_dismiss = {
	type = owncountry
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_xp_enabled = yes
			has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_filled
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = cc_office_seneschal_filled
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = cc_office_tt_dismiss }
			hidden_effect = {
				cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = seneschal }
				cc_office_publish_roster = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}

	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_xp_enabled = yes
			has_variable = cc_office_permanent_secretary_filled
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = cc_office_permanent_secretary_filled
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = cc_office_tt_dismiss }
			hidden_effect = {
				cc_office_vacate = { OFFICE = permanent_secretary }
				cc_office_publish_roster = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}

# Director of Public Instruction
cc_office_director_of_public_instruction_appoint = {
	type = owncountry
	price = price:cc_office_appointment
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_xp_enabled = yes
			cc_office_director_of_public_instruction_exists = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_office_director_of_public_instruction_vacant = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = cc_office_tt_room
				cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = cc_office_director_of_public_instruction_tt_candidate
				any_cabinet_character = {
					cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
					cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 3 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = cc_office_director_of_public_instruction_tt }
			hidden_effect = {
				cc_office_panel_clear = yes
				set_variable = { name = cc_office_panel_director_of_public_instruction  value = yes  months = 1 }
			}
			trigger_event_silently = { id = cc_office.3 }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}

	type = owncountry
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {

			cc_office_priori_of_the_council_exists = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			cc_office_priori_of_the_council_vacant = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = cc_office_tt_room
				cc_office_filled_count < cc_office_slot_cap
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = cc_office_priori_of_the_council_tt_candidate
				any_cabinet_character = {
					cc_office_can_be_appointed = yes
					cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = cc_office_priori_of_the_council_tt }
			hidden_effect = {
				cc_office_panel_clear = yes
				set_variable = { name = cc_office_panel_priori_of_the_council  value = yes  months = 1 }
			}
			trigger_event_silently = { id = cc_office.3 }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}
